params.baseInstructions: Play declarer and dummy using the supplied decision-time information. Write in English and pursue the stated objective. selectedCard is the single card from the acting hand to play now; publicReason briefly explains it. A plan is advice, not an observed event. plan.update replace installs plan.text, keep retains the previous plan, and withdraw removes it; use null text for keep or withdraw. Provide an initial concrete plan before dummy's first play. Unknown cards remain unknown.
